about: 1997 walkable ground inside a hardness outline that Dink's capsule could not enter at the reference world scale and fits at the enlarged scale (doc/remaster/WORLD_SCALE.md 14.1). With the physical play layer's part Collision on, each rect (map pixels, inclusive) joins the screen's low collision for Dink's capsule only; get_hard, brains and missiles keep the 1997 hardness, and the layer-off probe never reads this file. Rows are reviewed findings of Scripts/check_capsule_gaps.py (its --suggest output for the closed pockets, 26 Nov 2026): a rect may only cover a pocket that no walk of the 1997 map reaches (point Dink, every screen edge), whose edge the layer does not open (no relaxed box, no open tile) and that no 1997 warp lands in.
